mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, note_id, position_type, position_value, created_at, updated_at FROM bf_note_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND note_id = #{noteId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bf_note_progress (id, user_id, note_id, position_type, position_value, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{noteId}, #{positionType}, #{positionValue}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position_type = VALUES(position_type), position_value = VALUES(position_value), updated_at = NOW()
